topic: origin and location of cochlear macrophages
finding_paraphrased: Bone-marrow chimeras show constitutive bone-marrow-derived resident macrophages in the spiral ligament and spiral ganglion, replaced by marrow-derived cells over months and increased after local surgical stress
relevance: supports bone marrow as the adult source of cochlear macrophages (user premise); places them in the lateral wall and ganglion

topic: perivascular macrophages of the blood-labyrinth barrier
finding_paraphrased: Perivascular resident macrophages in the stria vascularis proliferate slowly and are largely replaced by bone-marrow-derived cells within 10 months after irradiation
relevance: slow marrow-derived turnover: resident macrophage numbers are not expected to oscillate within a day

niche: spiral ligament; stria vascularis; spiral ganglion
finding_paraphrased: Resident macrophages occupy the spiral ligament, spiral ganglion and stria vascularis; Csf1-deficient mice lack them in the spiral ligament and stria vascularis but not in the ganglion
Embryonic cochlear resident macrophages arise from yolk-sac (Csf1r-dependent) and fetal-liver (circulation) haematopoiesis
relevance: caveat: embryonic seeding is not from bone marrow; adult replacement is (Okano 2008; Shi 2010)

finding_paraphrased: After 8-16 kHz noise (106-120 dB, 2 h) CD45+ marrow-derived mononuclear phagocytes increase strongly at 1-14 days, concentrated in the spiral ligament and spiral limbus
relevance: post-noise recruitment window (days) for the response analyses

topic: CD45+ cochlear immune cells after noise
finding_paraphrased: In CD45+ cochlear cells neutrophils increase 3 days after noise; monocytes carry almost all differentially expressed genes at 3 days

topic: day vs night noise single-cell response
niche: organ of Corti + lateral wall + modiolus
finding_paraphrased: Macrophages are the main immune responders 3 days after noise; NLRP3 inflammasome / IL-1β activation is stronger after night (ZT14-16) than day (ZT2-4) exposure; macrophage depletion restores night-exposure hearing
